_meta.what: Today's IGRM scores: per-channel press-salience percentiles and their unweighted mean.
_meta.units: percentile of the channel's own trailing 730 days, 0-100
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/

definition: Measures press salience: the share of global news coverage matching each channel, ranked against its own trailing two years. Not a measure of risk, and not investment advice.
